collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page and pricing/limits page (English) around 10:33 Beijing time / 02:33Z on 2026-11-10. RSC payload (modelScope and planScope) and the model tables on the plan page, the pricing-limits wording and the /pricing page were read as published, and the same three pages captured on 2026-11-09 were compared line by line. One new paid model observed, no free variant observed, plus four same-day observations on the free model list, on a non-GOAT plan model, on the /pricing changelog and on the shared pool wording recorded for context. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One new paid model observed: 'Muse Ember' (slug muse-ember, id meta/muse-ember on the plan page, id muse-ember on the pricing-limits page) in the GOAT model catalog, vendor Meta, category opensource, blurb 'multimodal reasoning for conversational and agentic work', launchedAt 2026-11-08, minPlanName Go, 1M context (1048576 tokens), reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored'. Three-part price $0.10 input / $0.50 output / $0.004 cached read per 1M tokens, no cache-write price listed, and $20 per-model monthly credits on the GOAT plan (RSC budgetUsd 20, no budgetSteps, credits column '$20'). The RSC payload additionally carries blendedCostPerMTok 0.2 and agentLoopInputPerMTok 0.0328 for this model, transcribed as published. The GOAT 'All plans' model counter on the plan page moved 98 -> 99, and the pricing-limits All counter moved 100 -> 101. No free variant observed for this model (no muse-ember:free). The other previously listed paid GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps, and the shared-pool wording did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no shared-pool change, no other GOAT row changes, no adopted.csv row.

previousCapture.note: The 2026-11-09 baseline used here is the same-pages re-capture taken on 2026-11-09 for the 2026-11-10 comparison; it is not stored as a separate research file in this repo. The last stored GOAT capture is data/research/goat-dsv41-flash-ultrafast-round1-2026-11-07.json.
